finding.description: tiktoken with WASM bindings for JS runtimes
finding.recommendation: Existing character-based approximation (1 token ≈ 4 chars) is sufficient for MVP. tiktoken WASM adds ~500KB bundle size for marginal accuracy gain. Keep approximation for now; can upgrade later if needed.
finding.code_pattern: import { get_encoding, init } from "tiktoken/init"; await init((imports) => WebAssembly.instantiate(wasm, imports));

finding.optimal_chunk_size: - LlamaIndex: 1024 characters with 20-character overlap - LangChain: 1000 chunk size with 200 overlap - Firecrawl: 512 characters with 50-character overlap - Project target: 512-2048 tokens (matches best practices)
finding.overlap_strategies: - Small overlap (20-50 chars): Minimal context continuity - Medium overlap (100-200 chars): Balanced (recommended) - Large overlap (200+ chars): Maximum context but more storage
finding.hybrid_approaches: - PDFs → page-level chunking (maintain page boundaries) - Web pages → recursive splitting (HTML structure) - Code → code-aware separators (functions, classes) - Long documents → hierarchical chunking
finding.key_insight: "Many production systems use hybrid approaches: route PDFs to page-level chunking, web pages to recursive splitting, and code to code-aware separators based on file type or content analysis."

finding.capabilities: - Figures: Detected via PDFPageProxy.getStructTree() with role="Figure" - Accessibility data: alt text available if PDF is tagged - Bounding box: bbox property provides spatial location
finding.limitations: - Tables: NOT directly supported by PDF.js - Captions: NOT extracted as separate elements - Requires tagged/structured PDFs for automatic detection - Untagged PDFs: getStructTree() returns null or less detail
finding.recommendation: For MVP: Implement pattern-based detection for figures/tables in text content. Look for patterns like "Figure 1:", "Table 2:", [FIG], [TAB] markers. Full PDF structure parsing can be added later for tagged PDFs.

finding.ui_patterns: - Horizontal lines at chunk boundaries with labels - Color-coded badges for chunk types (text, figure, table) - Hover tooltips showing chunk metadata (token count, position) - Click to jump to chunk in search results
finding.accessibility_considerations: - Chunk boundaries should use semantic HTML (hr or border) - Chunk numbers should use aria-label for screen readers - Toggle button should have proper aria-pressed state
finding.eight_bit_styling: - Use design tokens for colors (border-border-dark, bg-surface-darker) - Pixel-perfect borders (1px solid) - Monospace font for chunk badges - Retro-styled chunk indicators
